title: Coherent scalar tensor reduction square without braidings
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, an algebra map $\iota:E\to L$, and a scheme $W$ with $\ell$ invertible in every residue field. Let $F$ be the prescribed completed scalar extension on bounded constructible complete integral objects, $R_E,R_L$ the specified coherent reductions, $T_E,T_L$ the completed tensors, $J_E,J_L$ their specified whole-system closed tensors, and $H$ the derived whole-system scalar extension. Write $a_D(M,N):R_D T_D(M,N)\simeq J_D(R_DM,R_DN)$ for the prescribed tensor reduction comparisons and $\sigma:J_E;H\simeq(H,H);J_L$ for the representative-normalized derived scalar tensorator. There exists a natural isomorphism $p:F;R_L\simeq R_E;H$ such that, for every constructible pair $M,N$, $R_L(\lambda_{M,N});a_L(FM,FN);J_L(p_M,p_N)=p_{T_E(M,N)};H(a_E(M,N));\sigma_{R_EM,R_EN}$. Here $\lambda$ is the prescribed integral tensor scalar comparison. This is an equation of entire derived coefficient systems, with no braiding involved.

proof.text: Choose the normalized Roos models for the two published calculi and the primitive scalar realization. The transported scalar-normalization theorem and normalized-sequence counit effectivity make its coherent reduction an isomorphism. Whiskering the realization and counit gives a natural transformation on the ambient category; restrict it and form the natural isomorphism p.

Use tensorModelRealization with the same published calculus on each side. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_refl and the closed-tensor self-comparison formula identify its coherent tensorReduction with pullbackTensorIntegralReductionTensor. Apply the generic reduction_of_limit_square calculation to scalarTowerTensorLimitSquare. Rewrite the two tensor reductions and unfold the restricted scalar comparison to obtain the stated square.

theorem integralScalarTensorCoherentReduction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) (W : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)] :
    let F := sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
      (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι W
    let R := integralSystemReduction l E W
    let Q := integralSystemReduction l L W
    let H := integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι W
    ∃ p : F ⋙ Q ≅ R ⋙ H, ∀ M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E W,
      Q.map (integralTensorScalarComparison l E L ι W M N).hom ≫
        (pullbackTensorIntegralReductionTensor l L W (F.obj M) (F.obj N)).hom ≫
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l L W).systemClosed.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (p.hom.app M) (p.hom.app N)) =
      p.hom.app ((constructibleIntegralTensor l E W).obj (M, N)) ≫
        H.map (pullbackTensorIntegralReductionTensor l E W M N).hom ≫
        (ScalarExtensionTower.derivedSigma l E L ι W
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E W) (pullbackTensorCalculus l L W)).hom.app
            (R.obj M, R.obj N)
